1.explanation: The code sets up a Pagination component with only one item and a page size of 25. This configuration will reproduce the bug where the footer incorrectly uses plural terms for a single item and page. The issue is due to missing conditional logic to handle singular forms when the total number of items or pages is one.
1.bug_scenario: The pagination footer incorrectly displays '1-1 of 1 items' and '1 of 1 pages' when there is only one item and one page. It should use the singular form 'item' and 'page'.
